title: The Rare Penny Stamp
scene: Between 10:15 and 10:35 AM, the rare penny stamp vanished from the sorting desk. The mailroom has a scanner log and a window to the dock.

suspects.name: Esther Yoon
suspects.testimony: I sorted parcels in the mailroom from 10:10 to 10:40 AM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The mailroom scanner log and Gloria's view through the window confirm Esther was alone.

suspects.name: Gloria Mendez
suspects.testimony: I loaded mailbags outside the open mailroom window from 10:10 to 10:40 AM; only Esther was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The dock supervisor helped Gloria lift mailbags outside the window from 10:10 to 10:40 AM.

suspects.name: Malcolm Briggs
suspects.testimony: I was in the mailroom with Esther from 10:10 to 10:40 AM, helping her stack the parcel bins.
suspects.contradiction: Gloria saw Esther alone in the mailroom, and the penny stamp was tucked inside Malcolm's wallet.

suspects.name: Bernard Clay
suspects.testimony: I weighed letters right beside the sorting desk from 10:15 to 10:35 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two customers watched Bernard weighing letters beside the sorting desk from 10:15 to 10:35 AM.
